latest_release.body:
## [terraform-provider-talos 0.13.0-alpha.1](https://github.com/siderolabs/terraform-provider-talos/releases/tag/v0.13.0-alpha.1) (2026-11-17) Welcome to the v0.13.0-alpha.1 release of terraform-provider-talos! *This is a pre-release of terraform-provider-talos* Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at https://github.com/siderolabs/terraform-provider-talos/issues. ### talos_machine `talos_machine` can now be imported, and has a new `drain_timeout` attribute that caps how long pod eviction may take during an upgrade. `drain_on_upgrade` copes better with a create that runs before the cluster is ready: a node that has not joined the cluster yet is not drained, a node that is not Ready is drained but not waited for before it is uncordoned, and a node whose machine config sets `skipNodeRegistration` is never drained. A failed drain now uncordons the node again, and a node that does not come back Ready after an upgrade stays cordoned, with an error that says how to uncordon it. See the resource guide. ### Component Updates Talos sdk: v1.14.1 ### Contributors * Mickaël Canévet * RoFz ### Changes
9 commits

* [`8eea0df`](https://github.com/siderolabs/terraform-provider-talos/commit/8eea0df1d766c8c4bbda5eb272666064d6b7cf02) release(v0.13.0-alpha.1): prepare release * [`d714bf7`](https://github.com/siderolabs/terraform-provider-talos/commit/d714bf7a4cfffeb7a5a668885e9136d6bed12dd3) fix(talos_machine): uncordon the node when the drain fails * [`57f67bc`](https://github.com/siderolabs/terraform-provider-talos/commit/57f67bcd54935e8264a32b96ff37aefb57c67262) fix(talos_machine): skip the drain on a node that hasn't joined the cluster * [`de2166d`](https://github.com/siderolabs/terraform-provider-talos/commit/de2166da35d59d61c9a5963f9054a8738750998d) fix(talos_machine): don't wait for a not-Ready node on create * [`d0d4997`](https://github.com/siderolabs/terraform-provider-talos/commit/d0d4997ec0c070ad4cd84023f7801585869617cf) chore: bump klauspost/compress to 1.20.2 * [`77d43fb`](https://github.com/siderolabs/terraform-provider-talos/commit/77d43fb0d45b92ee9c7fd7650948181908e35554) feat(talos_machine): add import support for existing nodes * [`0a16578`](https://github.com/siderolabs/terraform-provider-talos/commit/0a165787abccb03f3bd6d937ac81a655dc736525) feat(talos_machine): add drain_timeout to configure eviction cap * [`5073c3b`](https://github.com/siderolabs/terraform-provider-talos/commit/5073c3bc10045f9a57d1c92648a418dde6037a43) fix(talos_machine_configuration): preserve empty search domains in ResolverConfig patch * [`9339349`](https://github.com/siderolabs/terraform-provider-talos/commit/9339349161058eaa0b711766c113826cc7fa1f4c) chore: bump go to 1.26.10 and fix hardcoded talos version in test

### Dependency Changes * **github.com/siderolabs/gen** v0.8.7 -> v0.8.8 * **github.com/siderolabs/talos** v1.14.0 -> v1.14.1 * **github.com/siderolabs/talos/pkg/machinery** v1.14.0 -> v1.14.1 * **golang.org/x/crypto** v0.55.0 -> v0.57.0 * **golang.org/x/mod** v0.40.0 -> v0.41.0 * **google.golang.org/protobuf** v1.36.12 **_new_** Previous release can be found at [v0.12.0](https://github.com/siderolabs/terraform-provider-talos/releases/tag/v0.12.0)

detail.readme:
# terraform-provider-talos

## Debugging

In a bash shell, build a debug version of this provider binary:

```bash
make build-debug
```

In Visual Studio Code, [start the provider in a debug session](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/debugging#starting-a-provider-in-debug-mode).

In a new bash shell, go into your terraform project directory, and run
terraform with `TF_REATTACH_PROVIDERS` set to the value printed in the VSCode debug windows.
